fact: In collaboration with MinAgri and the Rwanda Space Agency, a pilot fine-tuned the Galileo remote sensing model to map maize, beans, rice and Irish potatoes within season in Nyagatare, Musanze, Nyabihu and Ruhango districts.
title: Galileo pretrained remote sensing model – Rwanda crop type classification
publisher: Alliance of Bioversity International and CIAT (CGSpace)
